identity_evidence.applicability: Japan-only pre-1999 Gracia Wagon per Drom Gracia Japan MCV21W/SXV20W/SXV25W catalog; original Japanese uploader expressly identifies Gracia. White long-roof wagon with small rectangular pre-facelift lamps, three-horizontal-slat pale grille and rectangular fog lamps matches the actual 1996–1999 Japanese catalog photo. Fits frozen 1996–2000 Gracia Wagon exterior representative only, not facelift or Sedan.
identity_evidence.actual_visual_observation: 完整白色两色五门长顶旅行车、纵向顶轨/长后侧窗/前后侧门、早款小长方灯/白三横格栅和雾灯实际对应，前方1/3至1/2机位；两轮/镜/车顶完整，无邻车遮挡。原件仅640×480，如实保留分辨率，不能冒称高分辨率。
